method: Owner-authorized YouTube Analytics user-activity report with subscribedStatus at event time and matched views/engagedViews/watch minutes, with format and date stratification; no public subscriber roster or account actions used.
population: Viewed activity on one authorized creator channel per matching report window, not global subscribers, deduplicated people or confirmed purchasers

separations.reason: Current subscription relationships do not guarantee watching or unique viewers.
A person can watch multiple times and switch subscription state during a reporting period.
Returning non-subscribers may watch repeatedly; status does not identify first-time audiences.
The subscriber-feed referral class is a traffic origin, not the same as whether every viewer is subscribed.
After platform view definition changes, engaged and raw starts differ; never pool without metric compatibility.
Minutes are additive within the same report grain but not a user population or a cash measurement.

measurement_gates: Only accept the two distinct status category rows if the owner report actually includes both, including explicit zero rows where returned.
Match period, format, region, channel, metric definition and access basis between rows before calculating shares.
Reconcile subscriber-status view totals against a compatible owner total and identify omitted/suppressed activity before treating them as complete.
Do not substitute subscriber growth, viewer demographics or public video views for owner-only subscriber-status views.
A switch of status within the period is not two different unique people.
Do not infer subscriptions, transactions, conversion rate or earnings from attention status.
